title: Needs Apple Watch support
text:
When switching from lbs to kg (during travel) then switching back, the app didn’t adjust the numbers correctly ultimately having all my progress tracked being incorrect. The lbs were essentially double my actual weight lifted per exercise. 

Also needs Apple Watch support. Would be nice to workout without my phone. 

Other than that it’s been fine.

title: Question
text: Does this app count reps for you?  I literally need an app that can reps, and can be adjusted to hold reps for a fee seconds.  I downloaded this but its too involved.. :/

title: Needs fixes
text: Can’t use keep phone toggle staying on. Also please add a beep when phone is locked so we can hear In headphones.

title: Great idea software quality
text: Great idea and functionality. Occasional but extremely frustrating crashes losing workout and changes. Timer does not always ding. It just crashed during a long workout. Gurrrrr…

title: Deletes logged info
text: If I exit out of the app in the middle of a workout, 99% of the time it deletes the typed info I log. Pretty irritating.

title: Loved previous version
text: Do not like the version now that fails to allow easy access to “one rep max” based on weight and reps over 10 reps.  How can I revert to old version?

title: App is good but
text: I like that it uses the Dynamic Island but the problem is your app don’t have all the exercises in the app it is limited to what’s is already there

title: Buggy
text: Sometimes there’s no option to finish the workout and the timer keeps running. Kind of annoying
